name: codex-personal-assistant-starter
description: Starter plugin for setting up a local Codex Personal Assistant workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap a local Codex personal assistant.
interface.longDescription: Guides a Mac or Windows user through creating a local Codex Personal Assistant workspace, answering first-run onboarding questions, and producing reviewable context, state, workflow, and template files. The starter does not connect external systems or publish content without explicit user approval.
defaultPrompt: Set up my Codex Personal Assistant.
Create starter assistant files on my computer.
